title: 5 CD Lot: Streisand, Round Midnight, Basia, Johnny Mathis, Dance With Me
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Discs and jewel cases show normal light wear consistent with age/storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Lot of 5 pre-owned vocal, pop-jazz and soundtrack CDs. Includes:

Barbra Streisand - Back to Broadway (Columbia, 1993)
Round Midnight - Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (Columbia, 1986), produced by Herbie Hancock, featuring Dexter Gordon, Chet Baker, Bobby McFerrin, Freddie Hubbard and Ron Carter
Basia - Time and Tide (Epic, 1987)
Johnny Mathis & Deniece Williams - That's What Friends Are For (Columbia)
Dance With Me - Music From The Motion Picture (Sony, 1998), featuring Gloria Estefan, Vanessa Williams, Chayanne, Jon Secada and Ruben Blades

All 5 CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.
